sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् सीतया वाक्यकोविदः ।प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां रामपत्नीं यशस्विनीम् ।। ६.११६.४७ ।।
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān sītayā vākyakovidaḥ ।pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṁ rāmapatnīṁ yaśasvinīm ।। 6.116.47 ।।

translations.english: "Sinners or noble men, having done a wrong deed and deserve death. Also noble, will show compassion and not commit harm."
